market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil above $100 drives rate-hike repricing, banks fall, iron ore weak. Expect volatility in ^AXJO and ^AORD. Gold and energy outperform; materials and REITs lag. RBA commentary critical.
market_outlook.long_term: If RBA prioritises inflation over growth, recession risk elevates. Structural iron ore weakness persists. Gold, copper, and energy offer medium-term support. Housing bifurcation continues. Data centre demand supports utilities long-term but strains grid.
